mail/imap#

IMAP capabilities (RFC 3501, RFC 9051): what a CAPABILITY response advertises.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let capabilities = ParsedImapCapabilities(line).capabilities();
capabilities.features().membership(ImapFeature.idle);
capabilities.authentication();          // ["PLAIN", "XOAUTH2"], in order

Description#

IMAP capabilities (RFC 3501, RFC 9051): what a CAPABILITY response advertises.

IMAP4rev1 or IMAP4rev2 is required; the features either implies are not assumed. Unknown tokens are kept as spelled. After STARTTLS or login the server's capabilities change: read them again rather than merging. By default 256 tokens of 256 bytes, 64 KiB in all.
